passageTitle: Questions 176-180 refer to the following receipt and e-mail.
passageHtml:
Document 1: Bakery Order Receipt

SWEET CORNER BAKERY

Order #: 4092 | Customer: Kevin Tran (Apex Office)

Delivery Date: Friday, May 12, at 2:00 P.M.

Items: 1 Large Chocolate Cake ($35) + 20 Cupcakes ($40)

Total Paid: $75.00

Document 2: E-mail

To: orders@sweetcorner.com

From: Kevin Tran (ktran@apexoffice.com)

Subject: Change of delivery time — Order #4092

Hello,

Our office party on Friday, May 12, has been moved earlier. Could you please deliver our cake and cupcakes at 11:30 A.M. instead of 2:00 P.M.?

The address is still 210 Main Street, Floor 4. Please call me at 555-0133 when you arrive. Thank you!

questions.q: What did Kevin Tran order from Sweet Corner Bakery?
questions.translation: Kevin Tran đã đặt món gì từ Tiệm bánh Sweet Corner?
questions.explanation: Hóa đơn ghi 'Items: 1 Large Chocolate Cake ($35) + 20 Cupcakes ($40)'.

questions.q: How much did Kevin Tran pay in total?
questions.translation: Tổng cộng Kevin Tran đã trả bao nhiêu tiền?
questions.explanation: Hóa đơn ghi 'Total Paid: $75.00'.

questions.q: Why did Kevin Tran send the e-mail?
questions.translation: Tại sao Kevin Tran gửi email?
questions.explanation: Tiêu đề email ghi 'Change of delivery time' (Thay đổi thời gian giao hàng).

questions.q: What time does Kevin want the food delivered now?
questions.translation: Bây giờ Kevin muốn giao đồ ăn vào lúc mấy giờ?
questions.explanation: Email viết 'Could you please deliver our cake and cupcakes at 11:30 A.M. instead of 2:00 P.M.?'

questions.q: What should the delivery driver do upon arriving at 210 Main Street?
questions.translation: Tài xế giao hàng nên làm gì khi đến số 210 Main Street?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối email viết 'Please call me at 555-0133 when you arrive.'

passageTitle: Questions 181-185 refer to the following advertisement and text messages.
passageHtml:
Document 1: Advertisement

GREEN LEAF SUPERMARKET — MEMBER CARD

Join our Member Club today for only $10 a year!

  • Get 10% off fresh fruits and vegetables every day.
  • Enjoy free parking for two hours when you spend $25 or more.
  • Earn points to get free coffee at our store cafe.

Document 2: Text Messages

Mina (4:10 P.M.): Hi Leo! Are you going to Green Leaf Supermarket after work?

Leo (4:12 P.M.): Yes! I need to buy apples and carrots for dinner.

Mina (4:13 P.M.): Great! Did you get their member card yet? You can save 10% on fruit and vegetables.

Leo (4:15 P.M.): Not yet, I will sign up at the customer desk today. It only costs $10!

questions.q: How much does a Green Leaf Supermarket member card cost per year?
questions.translation: Thẻ hội viên siêu thị Green Leaf có giá bao nhiêu một năm?
questions.explanation: Quảng cáo ghi 'Join our Member Club today for only $10 a year!'

questions.q: How can members get two hours of free parking?
options: By buying coffee at the cafe
questions.translation: Hội viên có thể được đỗ xe miễn phí hai giờ bằng cách nào?
questions.explanation: Quảng cáo ghi 'Enjoy free parking for two hours when you spend $25 or more.'

questions.q: What does Leo plan to buy for dinner?
questions.translation: Leo dự định mua gì cho bữa tối?
questions.explanation: Leo nhắn 'I need to buy apples and carrots for dinner.'

questions.q: What discount will Leo get on his apples and carrots with the card?
questions.translation: Leo sẽ được giảm giá bao nhiêu cho táo và cà rốt khi dùng thẻ?
questions.explanation: Quảng cáo và Mina đều nhắc '10% off fresh fruits and vegetables'.

questions.q: Where will Leo sign up for the member card?
questions.translation: Leo sẽ đăng ký thẻ hội viên ở đâu?
questions.explanation: Tin nhắn cuối của Leo ghi 'I will sign up at the customer desk today.'

passageTitle: Questions 186-190 refer to the following schedule and two e-mails.
passageHtml:
Document 1: Weekend Movie Schedule — Star Cinema

MovieTypeSaturday Times
Ocean TrainAction2:00 P.M., 7:00 P.M.
Happy DogComedy1:30 P.M., 5:00 P.M.
Winter SongDrama4:00 P.M., 8:00 P.M.

Document 2: E-mail

From: Paul | To: Hannah | Subject: Saturday movie

Hi Hannah, let's go to Star Cinema this Saturday! I want to see the comedy Happy Dog at 5:00 P.M. Afterward, we can eat dinner next door. Let me know if that time works for you.

Document 3: Reply E-mail

From: Hannah | To: Paul | Subject: Re: Saturday movie

Hi Paul, 5:00 P.M. is great! I love comedies. I will buy our two tickets online tonight. Let's meet in front of the cinema at 4:40 P.M. so we have time to buy popcorn.

questions.q: What type of movie is Ocean Train?
questions.translation: Phim Ocean Train thuộc thể loại nào?
questions.explanation: Bảng lịch chiếu ghi 'Ocean Train | Action'.

questions.q: Which movie do Paul and Hannah decide to watch?
questions.translation: Paul và Hannah quyết định xem bộ phim nào?
questions.explanation: Paul đề nghị xem phim hài 'Happy Dog' lúc 5:00 P.M. và Hannah đồng ý.

questions.q: What do they plan to do after the movie?
questions.translation: Họ dự định làm gì sau khi xem phim?
questions.explanation: Paul viết 'Afterward, we can eat dinner next door.'

questions.q: Who will buy the movie tickets?
questions.translation: Ai sẽ mua vé xem phim?
questions.explanation: Hannah viết 'I will buy our two tickets online tonight.'

questions.q: Why does Hannah want to meet at 4:40 P.M.?
options: To eat dinner before the movie
To wait in line for tickets
To have time to buy popcorn
questions.translation: Tại sao Hannah muốn gặp lúc 4 giờ 40 chiều?
questions.explanation: Hannah viết 'Let's meet in front of the cinema at 4:40 P.M. so we have time to buy popcorn.'

passageTitle: Questions 191-195 refer to the following price list, form, and e-mail.
passageHtml:
Document 1: City Bike Rental — Prices

  • City Bike: $6 per hour | $20 per day
  • Electric Bike: $12 per hour | $40 per day
  • Helmet & Lock: Free with every bike!

Document 2: Online Booking Form

Name: Daniel Cho | Date: Sunday, August 20

Bike Type: 2 City Bikes | Length: Full Day

Pick-up Time: 9:00 A.M.

Document 3: Confirmation E-mail

From: City Bike Rental | To: Daniel Cho

Thank you for your booking! Your two City Bikes are ready for Sunday, August 20, at 9:00 A.M. Please bring your photo ID to our shop at 15 Lake Street. You can pay by card or cash when you pick up the bikes.

questions.q: What is included for free with every bike rental?
questions.translation: Thứ gì được tặng kèm miễn phí với mỗi lần thuê xe đạp?
questions.explanation: Bảng giá ghi 'Helmet & Lock: Free with every bike!' (Mũ bảo hiểm và khóa xe: Miễn phí).

questions.q: What kind of bikes did Daniel Cho book?
questions.translation: Daniel Cho đã đặt loại xe đạp nào?
questions.explanation: Phiếu đặt ghi 'Bike Type: 2 City Bikes'.

questions.q: How much will Daniel pay in total for his booking?
questions.translation: Tổng cộng Daniel sẽ trả bao nhiêu tiền cho đơn đặt xe của mình?
questions.explanation: 1 City Bike cả ngày giá $20, nên 2 City Bikes cả ngày ('Full Day') là $40.

questions.q: What must Daniel bring to the bike shop?
questions.translation: Daniel phải mang gì đến cửa hàng xe đạp?
questions.explanation: Email xác nhận ghi 'Please bring your photo ID to our shop at 15 Lake Street.'
vocab: giấy tờ tùy thân có ảnh

questions.q: When will Daniel pick up the bikes?
questions.translation: Khi nào Daniel sẽ đến lấy xe đạp?
questions.explanation: Phiếu đặt và email đều ghi 'Sunday, August 20, at 9:00 A.M.' (sáng Chủ nhật).

passageTitle: Questions 196-200 refer to the following notice, bus schedule, and e-mail.
passageHtml:
Document 1: Company Notice

Date Change — Annual Company Picnic!
Due to heavy rain this Saturday, June 17, our company picnic at Silver Lake Park is moved to next Saturday, June 24. Lunch and games will still start at 11:00 A.M.

Document 2: Company Bus Schedule (June 24)

BusPick-up PlaceDeparture Time
Bus AMain Office9:30 A.M.
Bus BNorth Train Station10:00 A.M.

Document 3: E-mail

To: Mark | From: Emily | Subject: Company Picnic

Hi Mark, I am glad they moved the picnic to June 24 because I am busy this weekend! I live near the North Train Station, so I will take Bus B at 10:00 A.M. Let's sit together at the park. I am bringing my camera!

questions.q: Why was the company picnic moved to a new date?
questions.translation: Tại sao buổi dã ngoại công ty bị dời sang ngày mới?
questions.explanation: Thông báo ghi 'Due to heavy rain this Saturday, June 17, our company picnic ... is moved'.

questions.q: When will the picnic take place?
questions.translation: Buổi dã ngoại sẽ diễn ra khi nào?
questions.explanation: Thông báo ghi rõ buổi dã ngoại được dời sang 'Saturday, June 24'.

questions.q: What time does Bus A leave the Main Office?
questions.translation: Xe buýt A rời Văn phòng Chính lúc mấy giờ?
questions.explanation: Bảng lịch xe ghi 'Bus A | Main Office | 9:30 A.M.'

questions.q: Why is Emily happy about the date change?
options: She wants to ride Bus A.
She needs time to buy food.
She lives near the Main Office.
questions.translation: Tại sao Emily vui về việc đổi ngày?
questions.explanation: Emily viết 'I am glad they moved the picnic to June 24 because I am busy this weekend!'

questions.q: What will Emily bring to the picnic?
questions.translation: Emily sẽ mang gì đến buổi dã ngoại?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối email viết 'I am bringing my camera!'
